title: Are Resume Summaries Necessary? Here's How to Write One with AI
description:
Do you *really* need resume summaries at the top of your resume? It's a polarizing and highly-debated topic—and here's why we think it's worth including one on your resume. Feel otherwise? Let us know your thoughts in the comments. 

In this video, we'll go over everything from where to put a resume summary to how to write a resume summary and will talk through some good (and not-so-good) resume summary examples.
